description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2008 World Championships. Empoleon spreads damage across the opponent's Pokémon so that one or more can be Knocked Out when needed, and Claydol keeps the hand full. The 2008 World Championships were held at the Hilton Orlando Lake Buena Vista in Orlando, Florida, from 15 to 17 August 2008.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2008 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
